method: Saved little-endian FP32 logits widened exactly to FP64. Per row/profile subtract the raw maximum, apply NumPy FP64 exp elementwise, accumulate all entries with math.fsum, math.log, then subtract that log normalizer. Compare every FP64 log probability with inclusive 0.05; do not round before comparison. NumPy argmax returns the first/lowest vocabulary ID without tie tolerance.

archived_provenance.reference_arithmetic: FP64 arithmetic, Half activations/KV, original FP32 affine weights and FP32 logits; independent CPU graph, not upstream BF16.
